title: Spindle solutions with hyperscalars in $D=4$ gauged supergravity
summary: We construct new classes of supersymmetric $AdS_2\times Σ$ solutions, where $Σ=Σ(n_N,n_S)$ is a spindle. Such solutions can arise as the near horizon limit of supersymmetric, accelerating black holes. The solutions are constructed using $D=4$ STU $U(1)^4$ gauged supergravity theory coupled to a charged hyperscalar, and can be uplifted to obtain smooth, supersymmetric $AdS_2\times Y_9$ solutions of $D=11$ supergravity.
